description: Travel domain extension. Booking intents are marked financial so callers must confirm.

intents.label: look up travel options
intents.description: Look up flights, trains, buses or hotels and their availability or prices, without booking.
examples: Show me flights from Delhi to Mumbai tomorrow
what trains go from Pune to Mumbai
cheapest flights to Bangkok in January
are there any buses to Manali tonight
flight options from Chennai to Singapore next week
negative_examples: book a flight from Delhi to Mumbai
plan a 3 day trip to Goa

intents.label: book a ticket or hotel
intents.description: Book or reserve a flight, train, bus, cab or hotel.
examples: Book a flight from Delhi to Mumbai next Friday
I need a hotel room in Goa for 3 nights, please book it
reserve a train ticket to Jaipur for tomorrow
get me two bus tickets from Pune to Bangalore
book a cab to the airport at 5am
reserve a table for four at an Italian restaurant tonight
negative_examples: show me flights from Delhi to Mumbai

parameters.name: destination
parameters.question: Where do you want to go?

verify_hypotheses: The user wants to book a ticket.
The user wants to book a hotel.
The user wants to book a cab.
